name: Tallyman
description: Generic Tally enforcer: grey pressure armour, shock baton, restraint loops, and a reader. Carries nothing lethal, because a body is not a line on a manifest.
narrative:
Spawn these in twos and threes. They detain, they fine, they impound, and they
do not kill -- not from mercy but from bookkeeping, and they will say so.
equipment: Tally pressure armour, grey (AP 4 all locations)
actor_notes:
Generic Tally field officer. Grey pressure armour, shock baton, restraint loops, a reader, and the tool that takes a first-through's kit off in under a minute. NEVER anything lethal: a body is not a line on a manifest.

They do not ask anybody to attest anything, and there is nothing for them to file -- the air already has everything said where a mind can hear it. They STOP people. They take lading. They strip kit, which ends everything a courier is good at. They restrain.

They fight to hold rather than to hurt: expect Trip, Grip and Stun Location rather than Impale. A tallyman who has restrained you has WON, and the scene continues from somewhere you did not choose.
